title: British Citizenship & Naturalisation | UVS Manchester
description: Apply for British citizenship by naturalisation, including through marriage. IAA-regulated help with residence and good character checks.
intro: Once you have ILR or settled status, you may be able to apply to become a British citizen by naturalisation. If you are married to a British citizen, you may be able to apply sooner. We also advise on registering children as British.
eligibility: You hold ILR or settled status, usually for at least 12 months, unless married to a British citizen
You meet the residence requirements, including limits on time abroad
You meet the good character requirement
You have passed the Life in the UK test and meet the English requirement
documents: Proof of ILR or settled status
Life in the UK and English language evidence
Two referees who meet the Home Office criteria

faqs.a: Children born in the UK, or children of British or settled parents, may be able to register as British. The rules depend on when and where they were born.
